name: Approval Consumer
summary: Consumes governed approval-application decisions for proposed changes and downstream release actions.
description: Uses approval.decision-apply to turn a proposal, reviewer decision, and guard facts into one deterministic applied or not-applied result. Needs an explicit approval outcome without coupling the capability to any specific application workflow or storage model.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes a final apply-or-do-not-apply decision after review, rather than a review-state transition decision itself.
Needs a governed approval application outcome, rather than an append-only successor revision assignment for versioned subjects.
